title: Understanding Factor Investing From a Quant Lens
description: A rigorous, formula-first introduction to factor investing for quant analyst aspirants, prop trading applicants, and systematizing traders. Covers the theory behind why factors earn a premium, the core factor zoo (value, momentum, size, quality, low-volatility), and the practical mechanics of scoring, backtesting, and combining factors into a portfolio. Grounded in NSE and BSE data, Nifty factor indices, and Indian smart-beta ETFs throughout.
